questions.title: What does a hint cost the player?
questions.explanation: A hint can be free, cost points, or be limited per game. This sets how the score is kept.

choices.label: Costs points
choices.description: Each hint takes 2 points off the question.

questions.title: Where do hints come from?
questions.explanation: Hints are written by hand with the question, or generated when asked for.

choices.label: Written with the question
choices.description: Authors add a hint when they add a question.

choices.label: Generated on request
choices.description: A model writes the hint when the player asks.

thread.author: owner
thread.text: Written, and the author can mark a question as hint-free.

answer.text: Written, and the author can mark a question as hint-free.

questions.title: How many hints per question?
questions.explanation: One hint keeps it simple; several give a way to step up from vague to exact.

choices.label: Up to three
choices.description: Each hint is more explicit than the last.

questions.title: Do hints work on timed questions?
questions.explanation: On a timed question the clock can keep running, pause, or hints can be switched off.

choices.label: The timer keeps running
choices.description: Reading a hint costs time as well as points.

choices.label: The timer pauses
choices.description: The player reads the hint without a clock.

choices.label: No hints on timed questions
choices.description: Timed questions stay as they are.

thread.author: owner
thread.text: Can the player see how many hints are left before asking?

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Yes. The button shows the number left, so I added a third choice that turns hints off for timed questions.

questions.title: Who sees a hint after it is used?
questions.explanation: Once a player has used a hint, it can stay visible in the review at the end, or be hidden again.

choices.label: Keep it in the review
choices.description: The review shows every hint that was used.

choices.label: Hide it again
choices.description: The review shows only the answers.

thread.author: owner
thread.text: Show it only to the player who used it.

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Players answer alone, so that is already the case. Do you want the review to show it or not?

thread.author: claude
thread.text: 'On request' needs a button on every answer. Is a plain yes or no enough?

thread.author: owner
thread.text: Show it on request, that is the point.

thread.author: claude
thread.text: That adds a second screen. Pick one of the two, or add your own wording to a pick.

decisions.decision: Hints are written with the question
decisions.why: A model call per hint is too costly.

decisions.decision: A hint costs 2 points, never below zero

answers.text: Written, and the author can mark a question as hint-free.
Can the player see how many hints are left before asking?
Show it only to the player who used it.
Show it on request, that is the point.
